main_text.p: אַרְבָּעִין Quadraginta: Item Quadraturæ, בְּאַרְבַּעְתֵּיהֶן In quadraturis, h.e. quatuor partibus ipsarum, Ezech. 1.8. Syr. ܐܪܒܥܐ Quatuor venti, Marc. 13. 27. Eliso ܐܠܝܣܘ, ܐܪܒܥܐ, Act.27.33.

בְּנִין רְבִיעִין Ch.& Syr.Quartus. Plur. בְּנִין רְבִיעִין Filii quartorū, hoc est, abnepotes ex quarta generatione, 2.Reg.10.30. Fœmin. רְבִיעָיְתָא Quarta, Dan.7.19. Matth.14.25. & רְבִיעָתָא Levit.19.24.
רְבִעוּת Quarta pars, Heb. רֶבַע. Itē Accubitus, Psal.139.3. מַרְבַּע Ch. Idem, Ezech.48.20.
רְבִיעוּרְ Ch. Pluvia, prima proprie quæ descēdit mensē Octobri, ut Aruch explicat, Deuter.32.2. in Jon. Rabbini & Talmudici vocant רְבִיעָה, quod legitur apud Kimchium Joelis 2.23.
רְבִיעִין Ch. Quadruplicia, instrumēta musica quatuor chordarum, juxta Aruch. 2. Sam. 6.5. Vide R. D. Kimchium.
ܩܕܪܢܛܠܝܐ Syr. Quadrantalia, nomen mensuræ, continens quartam partem cadi sive modii, Joh.2.6.
מִרְבַּע, מִרְבַּע Ch. Quadratum. Plur. masc. מִרְבַּעִין Quadrata, 1.Reg.7.31. Fœmin. מִרְבַּעָן Num.2.3. in Jon.
ܩܪܒܐ Syr. Vulva, matrix, Luc.2.23. ad Rom.4.19.
רָבַץ Hebr. Idem. Aphel Partic. Ch. מַרְבִּיצֵי בֵיתֵיהּ Accumbentes in domo ipsius, Genef.14.14. in Targ. Hierof. Vide quoque suprà in רְבָא, in מַרְבִּינִין.
רִבְקָא, רִבְקָא Ch. Saginarium, Heb. מַרְבֵּק, Amos 6.4. כְּעֶגְלֵי רִבְקָא Ut vituli saginarii, Mal.4.2.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words are reproduced as closely as the scan allows; several vocalised forms are uncertain and are not marked individually. The Syriac line of Elisa and Quadrantalia may be imperfect.
